info.title: EnterpriseOS live application API
info.description: Contract inventory derived from the shipped Java controllers. JSON request/response bodies unless a logo binary is returned. Scope is identity, tenant administration and workforce/project operations only; no Phase 3?5 product endpoints are implied. Cookie sessions are validated against current tenant and membership state. API mutations require an allowed Origin; no cross-origin CORS API is provided. Query-based lists return arrays. Workforce record lists currently return the full authorized collection; core directories support bounded page/size parameters. Some record payload fields remain extensible JSON rather than a finalized domain-specific schema.

cookieSession.name: EOS_SESSION
cookieSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie; Secure is environment configured. Login sets this cookie. Tokens and password-reset/invitation secrets are never returned through administration lists.

otp.description: Required authenticator or unused recovery code when MFA is enabled.

password.description: At least 12 characters; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes (byte limit is enforced server-side).

AcceptInvitation.description: For an existing account, password must be the current password; an invitation never overwrites existing credentials.

logoKey.description: Empty string or /api/v1/org/logo; storage keys and remote image URLs are not accepted on writes.

LeaveRequestInput.description: Dates must be ordered within one calendar year. Working weekdays and configured holidays determine whole-day usage; pending/approved date overlaps are rejected. Policy must exist for the requested type and year.

days.description: Nonzero signed credit (+) or debit (-). A debit may not cause a negative balance.

Attendance.description: List responses include computed shift metrics; mutation responses return attendance state without necessarily including computed metrics. Overtime is informational, not payroll.

CorrectionInput.description: Only own attendance. Omit/empty outAt for an open session. Timestamps cannot be future, reversed or longer than 48 hours; overlapping sessions are rejected.

EmployeeInput.description: All references must belong to the tenant. Code and linked user are unique. History is maintained server-side. Offboarding deactivates the linked tenant membership and revokes its sessions. Other employees see an allow-listed directory view.

TaskInput.description: References must stay in the project. Assignee must be an active project member/owner. Parent/dependency cycles and archived writes fail. comments/history are server-maintained.

ShiftAssignmentInput.description: Employee assignments cannot overlap. Omit effectiveTo for an open-ended roster.

LeavePolicyInput.description: Type defaults to name; omitted year is a recurring default. Weekdays default Mon?Fri. ANNUAL grants upfront; MONTHLY accrues annualDays/12 at month start, rounded down to 2 decimals. Prior-year unused entitlement carries up to the cap. 2 stages require manager/delegate then distinct HR/admin; positive escalationDays permits HR escalation. Each request snapshots its policy.

RecordPayload.description: Schema is selected by the kind path parameter. Additional fields are persisted as JSON; server validation enforces references, role permissions and state invariants. No caller-supplied tenant identifier is trusted.

RecordUpdate.description: Partial update merged with existing kind-specific data. version must equal the current version. Omitted existing fields remain unchanged. Employee self-service accepts only version/name/phone/personalEmail/emergencyContact. Comments and history are server-maintained.

total.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

quantity.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

BusinessRecordPayload.description: Kind-specific JSON payload. Accounts/contacts/leads/activity masters use name and linked tenant references. Item requires sku. Documents quotes/purchaseRequests/purchaseOrders/expenses/invoices/rfqs/supplierQuotes require lines; invoice requires accountId, PO requires supplierId. Compensation requires employeeId/effectiveFrom, non-overlapping dates and nonnegative monthly salary components. Payroll requires periodStart/periodEnd (at most 63 days, non-overlapping). Budget requires positive amount/startDate/endDate. Supplier quote requires rfqId/supplierId; supplier contract requires supplierId/startDate/endDate and item price lines. Reservation/adjustment require itemId/warehouseId/nonzero quantity; adjustment also reason. Inventory count requires warehouseId and unique {itemId,countedQuantity,unitCost?} lines. Financial period requires non-overlapping dates. Currency/unit/valuation/serial tracking cannot change after stock postings. Status/tenant/createdBy are server controlled.

BusinessRecordUpdate.description: Partial merge with current record; version must match. Posted documents, payroll and extension workflows reject generic edits. DRAFT is required where applicable.

BusinessMovement.description: Tenant-serialized immutable stock posting. Active reservations reduce available quantity; negative stock is denied. FIFO consumes oldest eligible layers; expired batches are blocked for issues/transfers. Serial-tracked items require one unique serial per whole unit. Transfer posts both sides atomically. Unit cost is used for incoming stock; outgoing value uses the item valuation policy. Direct ADJUSTMENT requests are denied: create stockAdjustments and obtain a different reviewer approval.

BusinessReceipt.description: Lines require itemId and positive quantity; optional batch/expiresOn/serialNumbers. Receipt cannot exceed approved PO outstanding quantity. Supplier/item currencies must match; no implicit FX conversion.

BusinessReturn.description: Compensating stock return against an actual goods receipt. Cannot exceed its unreturned quantity; PO outstanding quantities update atomically.

amount.description: Signed nonzero correction amount; original finalized payroll is never modified.

quantity.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

reserved.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

available.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

inventoryValue.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

averageCost.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

reorderPoint.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

gross.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

deductions.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

net.description: Decimal business value; money is rounded HALF_UP to two decimals server-side; quantities support six decimals.

dataUrl.description: Base64 PDF/PNG/JPEG/WebP/UTF-8 TXT/CSV, decoded size at most 5 MiB.

leaveType.description: Existing leave policy type/name; normalized to canonical ledger type.

WorkforceExtensionPolicy.description: One versioned policy per tenant/kind, ADMIN/HR writes. Encashment uses tenure/minimum remaining/maxDays and never pays or debits entitlement. Comp-off uses actual recorded completed attendance by default, policy work-date window and hours-to-days conversion, with independent HR approval. nonWorkingOnly=true means weekend-only; set false only for an approved alternate rule.

WorkforceExtensionUpdate.description: Partial update; current version is required. All supplied references and merged data are validated.

WorkforceExtensionRequestInput.description: Own requests only; employeeId/userId/policy snapshot are server-derived. exits requires exitDate. encashments requires positive days within current eligibility. compOff requires past/current workDate and hours within configured limits and completed attendance evidence.

WorkforceExtensionRecurring.description: ADMIN/MANAGER or project owner configures template. Assignee must be active project member. A template cannot move between projects. Each tenant/template/date occurrence has a unique database constraint. Tasks use occurrenceDate as startDate and dueAfterDays as actual due date offset.

WorkforceExtensionAnalytics.description: Authorized real task records only; age from server created_at, overdue from actual dueDate/current state. Weekly throughput groups currently DONE tasks by latest completion history week in tenant timezone; no synthetic durations.

key.description: Reserved identity, authorization and property-path keys are rejected.

formData.description: Validated against the immutable latest published schema; unknown keys rejected.
